text_1.title: An insufficient diagnosis
text_1.content: Many infectious diseases remain undiagnosed today, representing a genuine public health scourge. Even when treatments exist, the lack of reliable, accessible diagnostics means some patients miss out on appropriate care and continue to spread these diseases within their communities.

text_2.title: Make diagnosis accessible
text_2.content: At AFYIA Diagnostics, we place innovative, simple, reliable, sensitive, and affordable diagnostics at the heart of our mission. Rapid and accurate identification of infectious agents is a crucial step in improving global health, particularly in settings where access to healthcare remains limited. A rapid and accurate diagnosis is essential for
text_2.list:
• Identify pathogens and guide appropriate care, allowing the administration of specific antiviral or antibiotic treatments.
  • Limit the transmission of pathogens through the implementation of targeted isolation and prevention measures.
  • Reduce the inappropriate use of antibiotics and contribute to the fight against antibiotic resistance.
  • Avoid errors diagnostics which could delay the treatment of serious pathologies, such as viral meningoencephalitis or certain bacterial infections.
  • Detect epidemics early and adjust public health policies.

text_3.content: Our ambition is to make high-performance diagnostics accessible to everyone, in order to better prevent, treat, and control infectious diseases on a global scale.

respiratory.title: About
respiratory.content:
Monkeypox is a rare viral disease similar to smallpox. Initial symptoms, resembling common illnesses, evolve into a distinctive rash.

Diagnosis is challenging, underscoring the importance of timely and accurate identification for effective management. With limited treatment options available.

team.title: AFYIA's staff
team.text: R&D is at the heart of AFYIA Diagnostics and this team is mainly dedicated to it.
team.text_2: AFYIA is a scientific company developing innovative solutions for diagnosing infectious diseases, combining molecular biology and artificial intelligence. This R&D is carried out continuously in our laboratory based in Grabels in the south of France.

about.title: About us
about.description:
While diagnostics is the primary means of combating infectious diseases, the vast majority of people living in low- and middle-income countries still do not have access to it. In these countries, infectious diseases are the first cause of mortality.

To help improve access to diagnostics for infectious diseases by developing high-performance, low-cost tools tailored to the needs and constraints of the most demanding laboratory environments, based on three areas of innovation: molecular biology, artificial intelligence and industrial processes.
about.one_health: This approach is based on the scientific and technical expertise acquired by Innovative Diagnostics, which has developed solutions for the veterinary and human sectors, from a "One Health" perspective in in vitro diagnostics.

timeline.text: AFYIA was born of the shared desire of its founders to address healthcare issues in developing countries using innovative technical solutions. The story began around ten years ago ...
timeline.title: is growing

pourquier.title: CEO
pourquier.text_1: A graduate engineer from AgroParisTech, I founded Innovative Diagnostics in 2004, a company specialized in developing ELISA and PCR reagents for the diagnosis of zoonotic and veterinary infectious diseases.
pourquier.text_2:
Today, ID employs over 170 people at its 5,000 m² headquarters in Montpellier and distributes its tests in more than 80 countries.

Driven by the importance of an integrated One Health approach linking human, animal, and environmental health, I expanded my activities by co-founding AFYIA Diagnostics in 2023. This company emerged from a collaborative initiative bringing together talents from Montpellier University and ID, with the ambition to make diagnostics accessible to the widest possible audience, particularly in countries of the Global South, within a framework of global health.

guy.title: Scientific director
guy.text_1: With a background as an agronomist and a PhD in microbiology and molecular biology, I have been working for over ten years in the field of biology and health, specializing in infectious disease diagnostics.
guy.text_2:
Passionate about scientific innovation and deeply committed to addressing healthcare access inequalities, I am now co-founder and Chief Scientific Officer of AFYIA Diagnostics, a company dedicated to developing innovative, robust, and accessible diagnostic solutions.

My scientific expertise lies at the intersection of applied research and technological development, aimed at tackling the critical challenges of diagnostic accessibility, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. My work focuses especially on major, emerging, and neglected infectious diseases, addressing key global public health challenges.

avarre.title: Scientific Consultant
avarre.text_1: As a researcher at IRD, I lead the scientific department “Ecology and Biodiversity of Continental Ecosystems,” where my work focuses primarily on the evolution and virulence of major pathogens in aquaculture.
avarre.text_2:
Convinced that frugal innovation offers a relevant solution not only to ecological and climate crises but also to North-South inequalities, I co-founded AFYIA Diagnostics. This initiative aims to make infectious disease diagnostics accessible to everyone, especially in countries of the Global South.

Achieving universal access to diagnostics has been a long-held dream of mine, as it would help reduce both the impact of epidemics and global health inequalities.

software.title: DISoft software
software.subtitle: AI-powered software
software.disoft_description: DISoft leverages AI-driven analysis of high-resolution DNA melting (HRM). This technology was developed through a long-standing partnership between Innovative Diagnostics, the Institut de Recherche pour le Développement (IRD) and the University of Montpellier.

access.description: Software access is provided with the purchase of a kit, for an unlimited time. To request an account, please fill in the form including your purchase reference. You will receive the procedure for accessing DISoft by e-mail.

software.disoft_description_2: Designed to work seamlessly with our diagnostic kits, DISoft processes and analyzes HRM data generated by thermocyclers. Developed by AFYIA, it classifies samples with advanced statistical and AI-based methods, ensuring precise and reliable results.

account_request.title: DISoft account request
account_request.description: To request access to the DISoft software, please fill out the information below.
account_request.text_accounts: Please add below the account(s) that will be affiliated with your laboratory.

software.disoft_description_3: With its user-friendly interface, DISoft allows users to explore and visualize diagnostic results with ease.
software.disoft_description_4: The technology behind DISoft is based on a patent co-owned by IRD and the University of Montpellier, and exclusively licensed to AFYIA.

process.description_1: AFYIA Diagnostics is an independent company with its own R&D capabilities and ISO 13485:2016 certified production facilities, ensuring an immediate response to health emergencies, as demonstrated by its response to SARS-CoV-2.
process.description_2: Around twenty employees work on the campus of our sister company Innovative Diagnostics, the world leader in veterinary diagnostics. These modern facilities span 7,000 m² and are located near Montpellier, France, giving AFYIA access to robotized industrial production capabilities.
process.description_3: All the components of our kits are manufactured on-site to guarantee the quality and availability of our reagents. These tests meet the highest standards of stability and standardization. Thanks to investment in the automation of our production line, we can produce freeze-dried kits at high throughput, making them transportable at room temperature.
